title: John Mills sees zigzagging object near Malmstrom
summary: Jesse Michels tells of John Mills sees zigzagging object near Malmstrom, about January 1993 at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in January of 1993 combat targeting team member John Mills recalls driving with a six person crew back to mstom base where he was stationed and seeing a bright object zigzagging around the sky
